description:
Welcome to Grid & Watt ⚡ Clear, honest explanations of electricity, power, and energy: from the outlet in your wall to the grid that powers the world.
If it runs on electricity, we break it down: how it works, what it costs, what's myth, and what's real.
Why "Grid & Watt"?
🔌 The Grid: the power system behind every outlet, city, and country
💡 The Watt: the unit that decides what everything costs to run
What we cover:
• Everyday electricity: bills, appliances, breakers, wiring, safety
• Gadgets and batteries: chargers, power banks, phones, laptops, EVs
• Energy tech: solar, wind, nuclear, batteries, heat pumps
• The grid: how power gets to you, why blackouts happen, how data centers strain it
• Energy fundamentals: voltage, current, watts, and power in plain English
New videos regularly. Subscribe to power up your brain. 🚀
⚠️ For education only. For any wiring or electrical repair, call a licensed electrician.
